title: 真・女神転生
sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written
The kana, digits and capitals by their order in the font, held against the screen; the few signs and small kana read in play. No kanji has come up: the opening is written in kana
Played from power-on: the dream (the gate, three namings, the pool) and the waking in the room, to the message on the computer

What the script said in play agreed with the lines read off 40 of 40 pictures of message windows, over 5 scenes; on 3 of them a question's first answer is shown and not said. Naming grids and status screens were left out as menus
notes: Read by the script games/sfc/SFC-56A9AAB6.lua. Text goes to the screen a row at a time through a list of writes the game keeps in work RAM, with voiced kana's marks as a second write one row above: the script says each row as it is written. A speaker's name is a row of its own. For its build it reads the cartridge's header in the first bank (LoROM), so it needs a host that gives that; whether the device's player does hasn't been checked. Menus, fights and the map aren't read as such, though their rows come out too.
